name: Cefpodoxime
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: About 29% to 33% of a cefpodoxime dose is excreted unchanged in urine, and its half-life rises from about 3.5 to 9.8 hours as kidney function falls. The US label lengthens the interval to every 24 hours when creatinine clearance (CrCl) is below 30 mL/min, and gives the dose three times a week after hemodialysis.

bands.recommendation: No dose change; the label changes the interval only below CrCl 30 (label).
CrCl below 30: usual dose every 24 hours (label).
CrCl below 30: usual dose every 24 hours (label).

hd: Usual dose three times a week, after each hemodialysis (label). A 3-hour session removes about 23% of a dose.
pd: No peritoneal dialysis dosing in label. Specialist input.
crrt: Not in label; the cited CRRT review (Li 2020) gives no regimen for this drug. Specialist input.
dialyzable: Partly: about 23% of a dose removed in a 3-hour hemodialysis (label). Protein binding 21% to 33%.
monitoring: CrCl for dose; kidney function with nephrotoxic drugs (label); diarrhea (CDAD).

pediatric.usual_dose: 12 years and older: adult doses (label). Younger children use the suspension, which is not covered by this tablet label.
